title: GoodCook Everyday 6" Mesh Strainer with Stainless Steel Mesh and Frame, Fine Mesh Sifter, Kitchen Strainer for Rice, Metal Sieve, Colander
description:
About this item
MULTI-FUNCTIONAL STRAINER: Catch seeds, strain liquids, or sift and dust dry ingredients with this versatile 6" mesh strainer. Perfect for a variety of kitchen tasks, this fine mesh strainer is an essential tool for any kitchen.
CONVENIENT SIZE: The medium 6-inch diameter is perfect for everyday use. This mesh strainer is ideal for various kitchen tasks, making it a versatile addition to your collection of strainers and colanders.
DURABLE STAINLESS STEEL FRAME AND MESH: The sturdy stainless steel frame and fine mesh catch smaller scraps and seeds, ensuring long-lasting performance and precise straining. Ideal for reliable and consistent kitchen use.
WIRE FRAME WITH HOOKS: The wire frame features two hooks to rest the strainer onto the rims of bowls and cookware. This design provides hands-free convenience, making it easier to strain liquids and sift ingredients.
LIGHTWEIGHT DESIGN: The lightweight design allows the strainer to be left on the bowl's edge for an extended time, enabling hands-free gradual draining. Perfect for tasks that require continuous straining without manual effort.

It’s sturdy, the mesh isn’t flimsy or crumbling in like you see sometimes with poorly made mesh sieves.Gets job done. No complaints.A Strainer like this is a must-have!I love the product and the price. It certainly came on time. I expected it later but upon leaving my package was there.Just as order.This is exactly what I was looking for. I mainly use it to wash rice, but I’ve also used it for a hundred different things. Would recommend.GreatHave been looking for a strainer that would stay on the pot. The 2 hooks on this strainer keep in in place nicely.This strainer is great!
